instruction: A full-shot cinematic still of a bright dance studio with large windows. On the left, the male dancer in the black top (R3) is in a wide squat with arms extended, holding hands with the female dancer in the purple top (R1) on the right, who stands on pointe. They look at each other. Natural daylight fills the room, casting soft shadows on the grey floor.
elements: R3 is in a wide squat with arms extended while holding hands with R1
R1 stands on pointe while holding hands with R3
R1 and R3 look at each other during the partnered dance contact

natural daylight casts soft shadows on the grey floor
